areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: General objective only punctually related; two indicators directly linked, others weakly; minimal resource share and low potential impact.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Transparency portal modernization and one directly linked indicator, but general objective not related, minimal resources and slight potential impact.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: General objective directly related; indicators easily verified; relevant resource share; moderate impact; digitalization is a core focus and solution shown more efficient than alternatives.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Core focus of the project; many indicators directly verifiable; over half of resources; high potential impact; solution shown more efficient than usual fiscal management.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Only a leadership-training product for female staff of the tax agency; no direct link to women's protection policies, minimal resources, indicator insufficient.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Own solar generation and efficiency in agency buildings does not strengthen national energy security; indicator insufficient, minimal resources.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Rainwater reuse in agency buildings has no direct bearing on national water security; indicator insufficient, minimal resources.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: General objective is related and resources relevant, but the indicators presented do not clearly show area results, so impact cannot be measured.
